name: Corvid’s Cunning
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (feathers or droppings from a crow, raven or jackdaw)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like fox’s cunning. In addition, once while the spell is in effect, the target can roll twice on a single Intelligence-based skill or ability check and use the more favorable result.

Corvid’s Cunning, Mass

School transmutation; Level bard 6, sorcerer/wizard 7

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

Mass Corvid’s cunning works like corvid’s cunning, except that it affects multiple creatures.
